# Season Shelf 1.2.5

This update fixes the library showing zero messages and no episodes after a successful scan.

Scan progress and other background updates could replace the UI state while a scan was running. Its completed result was then written into an old state object, leaving the screen empty even though the episodes were saved correctly. Restarting the app showed the saved episodes, but rescanning could hide them again.

The UI now preserves its state object across background updates, so completed scan results, episode rows, and message counts stay visible. Regression tests cover progress, queue, usage, update, and connection events arriving during a scan.

After updating, rescan affected channels. A restart is no longer needed to see completed scan results.

Windows installations can update from within the app. On macOS, download the universal DMG and replace the app in Applications. The builds remain unsigned and the macOS build is not notarized.
